A more detailed philosophy for purging specific systems will be developed in the next phase. 4.8 OPERATING PHILOSOPHY OVERVIEW 4.8.1 OVERPRESSURE PROTECTION All pressurized equipment will be protected in line with the expectations of ANSI, ASME standards, and API recommended practices. A remote vent will be provided to dispose of larger inventories in a location safe for personnel. Smaller local inventories will be relieved to atmosphere local to the equipment. Lessons from other terminals and storage facilities must be gathered and employed in later project phases to properly define venting configurations that are safe for field personnel and not subject to blockage due to dry ice formation. 4.8.2 METERING PHILOSOPHY As the plant will export LCO to another party, a custody transfer metering system is required. This 2 metering system will be installed on the liquid CO product line leading to the ship. Additionally, there will 2 be a connection to an analyzer to verify the product's quality. A similar system will be required for the vapor return from the ship. This system will account for the CO vapor displaced from the ship's tanks and 2 routed back to the liquefaction plant during the LCO loading process. 2 Furthermore, some form of allocation metering and compositional analysis will be necessary upstream of the liquefaction facility and at rail and truck offloading stations to ensure that the CO quality meets 2 specifications before entering the liquefaction process and storage tanks.
